title: Publish the OpenAPI contract
acceptance:
Story: the 0.2 client and every agent build against a written contract.
Expected: an openapi.yaml beside the server copy documents every route, the bearer scheme and the error shape, and the CI proves each documented route.
Not expected: generated client code or a public developer portal.
Depends on: the routes from WI-12 to WI-16.
Verify: the test run exercises every documented route.
evidence: openapi.yaml beside the server documents every operation, the bearer scheme and the error shape; QA confirmed a 1:1 route match, and CI now runs the server tests. PR #6: https://github.com/chakibelbassam/FoundationOS/pull/6.
